scope: source controls only; exact APIs pending author agreement

cases.requirement: Approved-input receipt must bind exact corpus/source/config payload, not only a claimed count
Synthetic controls cannot be relabelled as real without independently pinned changed provenance
Case IDs are unique and exact; groups may not cross development/calibration/heldout
Freeze is detached from caller mutation and rejects accessors/proxies/non-JSON
Gold never silently truncates and empty corpus does not pass rate thresholds
Runner projection excludes gold labels and does not reveal heldout expected outcomes
Source snapshot and config substitutions refuse
Invalid approval/unknown input fields fail closed
Exact actual allowed observation passes only its frozen selected scope and returned result
Denial and clarification remain distinct expected outcomes
Wrong route or accepted arguments fails
Wrong case/source/config/run hash fails
Wrong tenant/actor/client/binding/window fails
Altered returned action content or IDs fails
Action recommendation cannot be reclassified as accepted task/completed/delivered
Incomplete/empty/failed source cannot establish exhaustive absence
Missing cases counted explicitly without success dilution
Skipped/ineligible/failed cases counted separately with nonempty reasons
Unknown or duplicate observation IDs cannot displace required cases
Malformed observation stays visible as failure or rejects the batch, never silently dropped
Gold record recalls and any scope/count claims reflect full frozen expectations
Zero denominator produces unmeasured/ineligible status, never a manufactured perfect score
Synthetics remain separate from real/heldout denominators
Output observations detach from later caller mutations
Public threshold/gate values cannot be relaxed by caller configuration
CLI help and missing/invalid options are bounded; no network/source access
CLI ingestion/scoring matches library output and rejects wrong pins
Fresh outputs are exclusive; existing evidence remains intact
Oversized/untrusted files are bounded or explicitly refused without side effects
Original files/catalog/public0.1/empty real corpus are unchanged
Real corpus remains zero in local evidence, native/RG qualification unmeasured
Every raw failed replay/preimage and cleanup result remains in the packet
